COURSE.definition: The course as a whole, including its overall design, structure and the learner's general experience of taking it.

FACULTY.definition: The instructors, professors, teachers, mentors and teaching assistants who teach or support the course.

MATERIAL.definition: Course resources such as readings, slides, notes, handouts, textbooks and supplementary links.

ASSIGNMENTS.definition: Graded or practice activities such as quizzes, exercises, programming assignments, projects and homework.

PRESENTATION.definition: The lecture videos and the way course content is presented and delivered, including pacing, audio and visuals.

GRADES.definition: Grading of learner work, including auto-grader results, peer review scores and the grades shown on certificates.
